bibl.title: Monastic Wine Distributions in the Eighth century: Papyri from the Catholic University of America.
bibl.seg: Lajos Berkes & Nikolaos Gonis, Monastic Wine Distributions in the Eighth century: Papyri from the Catholic University of America.
bibl.note: Edition or reedition of Coptic and Greek papyri from the Catholic University of America. Most of the texts were published by: Leslie S.B. MacCoull, Coptic Documentary Papyri in the Hyvernat Collection, BSAC 27 (1985) pp. 53-60, figg. The texts come from Middle or Upper Egypt and most of them date from the eighth century. - I. Orders for Delivery of Wine: 1. Inv. 75.01; - 2. Inv. 75.17; - 3. Inv. 75.63 verso; - 4. Inv. 75.23; - 5. Inv. 75.22 verso; - 6. Inv. 75.46; - 7. Inv. 75.65; - 8. Inv. 75.43; - 9. Inv. 75.34; - 10. Inv. 75.18; - 11. Inv. 75.32. - II. Documents on the Back of the Orders: 12. Inv. 75.63 recto. Fragment of a Letter; - 13. Inv. 75.62 recto. Fragment of a Coptic Text; - 14. Inv. 75.32 recto. Fragment of a Letter. - III. Account of Wine Distribution: 15. Inv. 75.20. Wine Account. 7th/8th. - IV. Miscellaneous documents: 16. Inv. 75.105. Fragment of a Letter. 6th/7th c.; - 17. Inv. 75.107. Receipt from Rent of a Winepress. 7th/8th.
